result.topic_en: Calculations on rationalizing sums of square roots of products of linear forms, such as $\sqrt{xy}+\sqrt{zt}+\sqrt{uv}=0$, with auxiliary parameters, apparently related to relations among theta characteristics or bitangents.
result.transcription:
$\begin{matrix}1&1&1&1\\2&2&2&2\\3&5&7&9\\4&6&8&10\end{matrix}$
$f^2 = xyzt$
$e^2 = xyuv$
[-$f+e = xy$-]
$f - e = zt - uv$
$2f = xy + zt - uv = 2\sqrt{xyzt}$
$\sqrt{xy} + \sqrt{zt} + \sqrt{uv} = 0$ \quad $\sqrt{xy} + \lambda\sqrt{zt} + \sqrt{pq} = 0$
$x+z+u+y+t+v = 0$ \quad [-...-] \quad $x\alpha' + \frac{y}{\alpha'} + \lambda z\beta' + \frac{\lambda t}{\beta'} + p + q = 0$
$\alpha x + \beta z + \gamma u + \frac{1}{\alpha}y + \frac{1}{\beta}t + \frac{1}{\gamma}v = 0$ \quad $x\alpha'' + \frac{y}{\alpha''} + \lambda z\beta'' + \frac{\lambda t}{\beta''} + \gamma'' p + \frac{q}{\gamma''} = 0$
$(1-\lambda^2)\sqrt{zt} + \lambda\sqrt{uv} - \sqrt{pq} = 0$ \quad $(1-\alpha^2)x + (1-\alpha\beta)z + (1-\alpha\gamma)u + (1-\frac{\alpha}{\beta})t +$
[-$\lambda(x + \alpha y + \mu(z + \beta t) + \nu(u + \gamma v))$-] \quad [-$z$-]
[-$(\lambda + \mu)x + y + \lambda\mu(z+t) + \mu\nu(u+v)$-] \quad 8
[-$(\lambda+\mu)^2 z^2 t^2 = \beta^2$-]
$\lambda\beta^2 = \frac{\beta^2}{\lambda} = \lambda + \frac{1}{\lambda} + 2$
$\lambda = \frac{\beta}{\alpha}$ [?] \quad $\alpha\beta = \frac{\alpha}{\beta} + \frac{\beta}{\alpha} + 2$
$\sqrt{xy} + \sqrt{zt} + \sqrt{uv} + \sqrt{pq} = 0$
